A bride and groom, seen from behind, walk arm in arm along a sandy beach between golden rock formations at the water's edge.

A laughing bride with five bridesmaids in dusty-blue sequin dresses, all holding pink and white rose bouquets, in front of a pale shuttered building.

A bride and a groom in a blue suit walk on gravel in front of an orangery's arched glass doors and clipped topiary.
A groom in a beige suit dips the bride for a kiss on a sunlit path beside a white-walled chapel with a pointed roof.
A groom in a navy velvet tuxedo laughs as he walks with his groomsmen in black tie and buttonholes.
Close-up of a seated couple's joined hands, the groom in a navy tweed suit with a white rose buttonhole, with pillar candles and a brick wall blurred behind.
Chateau Lacanaud, France: close-up of a pink-rose and white bouquet against dusty-blue sequin bridesmaid dresses. A homepage hero slide; -scaled.jpg is 2560x1200.
Ibiza wedding (Iberostar & Nikki Beach): a two-photo layout of the couple kissing at the Nikki Beach bar and a portrait of them facing each other. Portfolio tile.
Natalie and Max smiling with their cameras in a sunny garden

notes: Logo: vector reconstruction (potrace via logo_trace.py, 2 colours #998c7c taupe and #606358 grey) of the business's own 1500x593 transparent PNG header wordmark; no genuine SVG exists. Traced from a 3x Lanczos upscale (transparent pixels de-matted to the brand taupe) so thin serif strokes keep their weight; mean abs diff 1.20 vs the source. Show on a light plate: the grey 'photo & films' line has poor contrast on dark.

Reel: six video clips cut from four of the business's own MP4s in its WordPress media library (Confetti Throw x2, Loule x2, Beach, Pinecliffs). No YouTube/Instagram footage was downloaded (not allowed in this session); the business has no TikTok.

Gallery: nine homepage hero slides (wide 5443x2551 'originals', resized to 1600x750). Research noted these originals may be upscaled; at 1600 px they look clean. Not used: the Ibiza two-photo portfolio tile (prominent Nikki Beach signage), the bouquet close-up (near-duplicate of photo-02's scene), and the 990 px team portrait (probably taken by a third party).

Oct 27 photo upgrade: card and gallery re-selected from original-resolution uploads on the business's own site and its own uploads on the old Booked Events site; AI renders, other businesses' images, private names and celebrity/watermarked shots excluded.
